title: 词性转换
goal: 能根据句法位置和语义填写派生词。

points.label: 按句法位置确定所需词性
结合语义填出正确派生形式

body.p: 词性转换指给一个词加前缀或后缀，变成同一词族的名词、形容词或副词。空格所在的位置决定用哪种词性，上下文决定用哪个意思。

body.box: The decision was careful. / She decided carefully.

body.p: decision 是名词，careful 是形容词，carefully 是副词。词形变化时还要核对拼写。

cards.title: 词性与位置
rows: They discussed the plan with enthusiasm.

cards.title: 名词派生
rows: 快乐；y 变 i 再加 -ness

cards.title: 形容词与副词派生
rows: 小心的；-ful 构成形容词
有用的；-ful 构成形容词
有创造力的；-ive 构成形容词
The team found a creative solution.
活跃的；-ive 构成形容词
He is active in the club.
快乐地；y 变 i 再加 -ly

cards.title: 否定前缀
rows: He was unhappy about the delay.
The task is impossible without tools.
粗心的；把 -ful 换成 -less 也表示否定
A careless move broke the cup.

items.why: Her 后的名词作主语，decide 的名词是 decision。
map 前需要形容词 useful。

items.stem: The students worked (careful) with the glass.
items.why: 副词 carefully 修饰 worked。

items.stem: The task cannot be done without water. It is (possible) without water.
items.why: 语境表示不可能，possible 加前缀 im-。

items.stem: The child was sad about the delay. He was (happy) about it.
items.why: sad 表示不快乐，用 unhappy。

items.stem: The child's (happy) was clear from her smile.
items.why: 物主限定词后用名词 happiness，y 变 i。

items.stem: This pattern is not common. It is (usual).

groups.text: A school club decided to create a guide to a nearby walking route. Members began by visiting the route and recording places where walkers might need directions. Their first [1] was to divide the route into several short sections. They then collected [2] about each section, including the location of paths and gates. One member drew a map, and another wrote a description of the starting point. The group wanted the instructions to be [3], so they asked another class to read a draft. The readers marked places where a sentence was unclear. Club members considered each comment [4] before revising the guide. They also noticed an [5] shape on an old stone beside the path. Because shapes like it were rarely seen there, they included a picture of it in the guide. After another visit, the group checked the distances and the names on the map. The final copies were placed in the school library, where walkers could borrow them before a trip. The club kept its original notes so that later members could update the guide if the route changed.

items.stem: [1] Their first (decide) was to divide the route into sections.
items.why: first 后需要名词 decision 作主语。
动词 collected 后需要名词 information 作宾语。

items.stem: [3] The group wanted the instructions to be (use).
items.why: 系动词 be 后用形容词 useful。
副词 carefully 修饰 considered。

items.stem: [5] The shape was rarely seen there. It was an (usual) shape.
items.why: rarely seen 表示不寻常，usual 加前缀 un-。

groups.text: A neighborhood group organized an afternoon of music for local residents. The group sent an [1] to each household and asked interested residents to reply. A student offered to play the piano, while two neighbors prepared songs. The group was grateful for the [2] shown by everyone who offered help. On the day of the event, the musicians arrived early to set up their instruments. One volunteer checked that the chairs were in safe positions. Another spoke [3] to the guests as they entered and showed them where to sit. The first song began after everyone had found a place. A planned performance later became [4] when a musician's instrument broke; it could not be played at all. The musicians adjusted the program and invited the guests to join a different song. At the end, the group thanked the guests and the volunteers. The organizer was [5] with the broken instrument but pleased that the program had continued. The group collected suggestions for another event and stored the music stands in a cupboard. Members planned to check the equipment more closely before the next performance.

items.stem: [1] The group sent an (invite) to each household.
items.why: 冠词 an 后需要名词 invitation。

items.stem: [2] The group was grateful for the (kind) shown by everyone who helped.
items.why: the 后需要名词 kindness，表示善意。

items.stem: [3] Another volunteer spoke (happy) to the guests.
items.why: 副词 happily 修饰 spoke，y 变 i。

items.stem: [4] The broken instrument could not be played. The performance became (possible).
items.why: 无法演奏使演出不可能进行，用 impossible。

items.stem: [5] The organizer was not happy about the broken instrument. The organizer was (happy) with it.
